title: Seeded RNG, stepped simulation and a probe per mechanic
note: A seeded rng, a stepped simulation and one probe per mechanic — what makes a build measurable by the harness at all.
intent: The same seed must produce the same run, always: seed(n) reseeds a local PRNG (never Math.random or performance.now() in gameplay), fully resets, and pauses; step(dtMs) advances the simulation by hand from the accumulated dt so the critic can press WASD with press_keys while paused and stepped. A game that only updates inside requestAnimationFrame cannot be played deterministically, and one that waits for start() before rendering ships a frozen black screen: the loop runs and draws on load, start()/pause() are the studio’s clock and pause() is the judge’s tool. A title, menu or countdown is welcome as the first screen — report it through config.flow and let config.begin take the game straight into play, so every judge drives from play. Sample input in update() from ctx.keys and ctx.look, not only a live keydown listener, and make every input produce a visible change within a frame or two. state() returns runtime timing plus truthful probes for implemented mechanics; do not invent score, player or entity counters for mechanics absent from the requested game, and every named config.demos entry drives a short control script to an end state a probe can verify — e.g. the player actually moved.

check.note: After the harness drives the game's own movement keys, state().player.x or .z changed; identical before and after means "the controls do not work". needs names the same paths delta() reads, so a build that reports no player — or one whose player only appears after the play script — is unmeasured, not passed.

port: Only the mainOwner facet edits src/main.js and src/studio.js: install window.__studio there, route every keyboard and pointer source into sim.keys / sim.look, and add one probe key to state() per mechanic the facet ships plus a named demo in config.demos that reaches it; run check_game after any structural change.

evidence.note: The contract service reseeds, resets and pauses, and steps independently of wall clock. Expose actual game state; no stock mechanics or scene are required.
every input produces a visible change within a frame or two; sample keys in update() from ctx.keys, not only a keydown listener
evidence is a deterministic playthrough, screenshots at named cameras, state() and console errors
